sanskrit_verse: यो 'दत्तव्यवहारत्वादनियुक्तः प्रवर्तते । वचनं तस्य न ग्राह्यं लिखितप्रेषितादृते ॥
transliteration: yo 'dattavyavahāratvād aniyuktaḥ pravartate / vacanaṃ tasya na grāhyaṃ likhitapreṣitād ṛte //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who acts without authorization due to absence of rightful engagement—his speech is invalid except when submitted in written form.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives solely from conscious capacity and lawful assignment
Unsanctioned action nullifies verbal claim unless documented
Responsibility arises only through legitimate invocation
Consciousness alignment determines validity of utterance
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.has_no_authorization AND action.is_verbal THEN statement.validity = false
IF agent.has_written_submission THEN statement.validity = true FOR unauthorized agents
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any testimony or declaration by a person acting outside their authorized scope shall carry no weight unless formally documented and submitted as part of legal procedure. This ensures that only those properly engaged within dharma-sanctioned roles influence judicial outcomes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unassigned speech lacks causal integrity; thus, it cannot contribute to Nyāya. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows misalignment precedes invalid expression. Responsibility is proportional to authorization. No punitive measure applies—the focus remains on restoring rightful participation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: DocumentationRequirementProcess: Unauthorized speaker must submit written account for review
CapacityReintegrationPathway: Assign corrective role enabling lawful future engagement
IntegrityVerificationLoop: Confirm alignment before accepting further declarations
ConsciousnessRealignmentSession: Facilitate understanding of source-based authority
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Speech without sanction holds no juridical ground. Dharma is restored through alignment, documentation, and conscious reintegration. Reality abides in non-punitive truth. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
